targetText:
The law of contradiction in things,
that is, the law of the unity of opposites, is the fundamental law of nature
and of society and therefore also the fundamental law of thought.
explanation: Mao summarizes that opposing forces drive everything: physical forces in nature, human history, and thoughts in our minds. Real-life example: Understanding this helps us stay calm during big life changes, knowing that tension and conflict are normal parts of growth.

targetText:
In studying the particularity and relativity
of contradiction, we must give attention to the distinction between the principal
contradiction and the non-principal contradictions and to the distinction
between the principal aspect and the non-principal aspect of a contradiction
explanation: Solving real-world problems requires separating the main issue from side issues, and recognizing which force holds power right now. Real-life example: A manager who focuses on office decorations while sales drop is failing to separate principal from non-principal issues.

targetText:
If, through study, we
achieve a real understanding of the essentials explained above, we shall
be able to demolish dogmatist ideas which are contrary to the basic principles
of Marxism-Leninism and detrimental to our revolutionary cause
explanation: The point of philosophy is practical: replacing rigid, outdated rules with real-world observation. Real-life example: Instead of sticking to an old plan that is failing, a smart leader analyzes current facts and adjusts their strategy to fit reality.
